0|335d1c5b545284d75ef96ee42e461eacefe865bb|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"bpf: Implement support for adding hidden subprogs
Introduce support in the verifier for generating a subprogram and
include it as part of a BPF program dynamically after the do_check phase
is complete. The first user will be the next patch which generates
default exception callbacks if none are set for the program. The phase
of invocation will be do_misc_fixups. Note that this is an internal
verifier function
column2: and should be used with instruction blocks which

column1: uphold the invariants stated in check_subprogs.
Since these subprogs are always appended to the end of the instruction
sequence of the program
column2: it becomes relatively inexpensive to do the

column1: related adjustments to the subprog_info of the program. Only the fake
exit subprogram is shifted forward
column2: making room for our new subprog.

column1: This is useful to insert a new subprogram
function pointer. The next patch will use this functionality to insert a
default exception callback which will be invoked after unwinding the
stack.
Note that these added subprograms are invisible to userspace
reported in BPF_OBJ_GET_INFO_BY_ID etc. For now
subprogram is supported
column2: but more can be easily supported in the future.

column1: To this end
column2: two function counts are introduced now

column1: func_cnt
column3: the latter including hidden programs. This

column1: allows us to conver the JIT code to use the real_func_cnt for management
of resources while syscall path continues working with existing
func_cnt.
